What is mental disability?

6. Twenty four per cent of the UK population report having a disability.146 Some people have
more than one disability. The prevalence of disability increases greatly with age. There is no
requirement for a judge to decide whether a person qualifies as disabled under the EqA

2010. This chapter (unless otherwise stated) uses the term “mental disability” to apply to
anyone who has a mental impairment which, as a result, may call for some extra
consideration to be given to their needs in the context of a court hearing.
